## Services
- [Landscaping](/services/landscaping): Garden design, planting, gravel gardens, bed shaping, turfing
- [Lawn Care](/services/lawn-care): Weekly mowing, edging, seasonal lawn treatment
- [Hedge Trimming](/services/hedge-trimming): Residential and commercial hedge maintenance
- [Garden Maintenance](/services/garden-maintenance): Ongoing care, weeding, pruning, tidying
- [Seasonal Cleanup](/services/seasonal-cleanup): One-off garden clear-outs and waste removal
- [Mulching](/services/mulching): Soil improvement and bed dressing

## Pricing
- [Pricing Guide](/pricing): Small lawn mowing usually £20-£30; average garden mowing £30-£50; regular maintenance from about £60; one-off tidy-ups from £80; hedge trimming commonly £5-£15 per metre; small landscaping projects from £500+
